description: This Java class 'ReadableCustomerAttribute' extends 'CustomerAttributeEntity' and provides getter and setter methods for 'ReadableCustomerOption' and 'ReadableCustomerOptionValue' objects. It represents a customer attribute with readable options in a customer-related context.

classes.name: ReadableCustomerAttribute
classes.description: Represents a customer attribute with associated options, inheriting basic attribute properties from CustomerAttributeEntity.

methods.name: setCustomerOption
methods.description: Sets the customer option associated with this attribute.

methods.name: getCustomerOption
methods.description: Retrieves the customer option associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Sets the customer option value associated with this attribute.

methods.name: getCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves the customer option value associated with this attribute.
